_doc: The New Gudauri buildings POC (decision 77). Footprints come from OpenStreetMap only (osm-buildings.json). This file adds what the map does not have: height source, look (colours, roof, facade) and where each look came from. Photos are never stored; each source is a fact with a link and a date. 'fill' = completed from the village's style, no photo of this building. See research/3d-buildings.md, section 7.

korter-alpic.what: korter.ge, Alpic page: facade photos and drone photos of New Gudauri in snow (viewed only)
